sections.title: Does Cigna Cover Addiction Treatment?
body: Yes, your Cigna insurance policy will cover drug and alcohol addiction treatment. As with other national and regional insurance providers, Cigna offers various levels of benefit coverage for its customers. When you sign up for Cigna insurance, you will choose the coverage level that best fits your healthcare coverage needs. Depending on your chosen level of coverage, your Cigna plan may cover most or all of your expenses related to alcohol or drug detox, therapy during treatment, housing and nutritional support, and aftercare services.

To help enhance its customer experiences, Cigna has created a specific division within its organization to help its policyholders better understand the benefits related to drug and alcohol addiction treatment. This special group of representatives, referred to as the Cigna Behavioral Health division, provides support services, tools, articles, and podcasts for individual policyholders and their family members. These “extra” benefits allow you to learn more about drug and alcohol addiction and various aspects of the addiction treatment process.

sections.title: How Long Will Cigna Cover Rehab?
body: As with most services covered by insurance, the duration of covered services for addiction rehab will range based on your coverage level and the type of drug treatment provided. Therapy sessions in the outpatient setting may occur one or more times per week for several months or up to one year.

Inpatient or residential rehab programs require you to “live” on-site at the treatment center throughout your treatment program. The residential nature of these programs provides many benefits, including a wide range of treatment options, 24/7 care and support, nutritional education, and access to medically supported detox services. Inpatient drug and alcohol programs generally last a minimum of 30 days; however, some can last for 90 days or longer, depending on your treatment needs.

Based on your chosen plan and coverage levels, Cigna may cover some or all of your treatment services at an in-network provider like Ocean Coast Recovery Center. Also, your insurance benefits may cover follow-up treatment or subsequent care in the event of a relapse.

sections.title: What Are the Benefits of Cigna Covered Addiction Treatment?
body: Cigna offers several levels of coverage; therefore, your specific benefits for mental health and addiction treatment vary based on your chosen plan. For example, although bronze Cigna plans have a lower monthly premium, they typically require higher out-of-pocket costs and a higher annual deductible than a platinum plan or another “higher” level of insurance coverage.

Cigna requires pre approval or pre-authorization before beginning treatment for some treatment services (frequently with lower coverage levels). If you are unsure about your coverage levels or if your plan level requires pre-authorization, it is essential to contact your plan manager or a member of our admissions team Ocean Coast Recovery before treatment begins.

It is also essential to consider the type of treatment or level of care you need to get well. Another factor that helps determine coverage and treatment cost is the region or state where you live. Some Cigna insurance plans will require you to seek treatment at Cigna in-network rehab facilities or Cigna-approved rehab centers. However, this is only the case with some Cigna plans, so contacting Cigna directly before beginning an addiction treatment program is essential that you understand how your insurance benefits apply to your treatment program at a Cigna drug and alcohol rehab. It is crucial to keep in mind that choosing a rehab that is an out-of-network provider will generally increase your out-of-pocket costs due to variations in Cigna’s agreements with in-network and out-of-network providers.

Cigna insurance benefits cover both services for both residential (inpatient) and outpatient addiction treatment services. Examples of covered treatments in a residential treatment program may include addiction therapy, detoxification services, medication management, and nutritional support. As previously noted, your insurance plan benefits and what Cigna will pay for services will vary based on your state of residence, chosen rehab, and coverage levels.

As previously mentioned, your specific coverage details and payment levels will vary based on your plan and your state of residence. In the outpatient treatment environment, your Cigna plans will often cover individual, group, and family therapies, detox medication management, intensive outpatient therapy services, treatment programs, and anti-craving medication management. Most Cigna-approved drug and alcohol treatment programs offer services for many needs, including prescription pain medications, alcohol, heroin, cocaine, prescription stimulants (i.e., Adderall), sleep aids, sedatives, marijuana, methamphetamines, and benzodiazepines.

sections.title: Ocean Coast Recovery Accepts Cigna Insurance
body: The best way to determine your benefit levels and understand how your Cigna policy will pay for your treatment needs is to check with Cigna directly or contact our experienced professionals at Ocean Coast Recovery Center. Plans and coverage levels do vary from person to person. Therefore it is essential to understand the particular details of your individual policy before committing to a specific addiction treatment program. Depending on your plan, Cigna may require a referral or pre-authorization before services at a drug or alcohol rehab center will be covered.

Ocean Coast Recovery is in-network with Cigna, and we accept Cigna benefits. Your policy may partially or entirely cover the cost of drug or alcohol detox and addiction treatment in Huntington Beach . Let us help you understand how you can use your Cigna benefits to take the first steps towards healing from addiction. We understand working with insurance companies and understanding your benefits can be challenging. Our admissions team will help you understand your plan and help you contact your policy advisor at Cigna to verify your coverage.
